first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: A white long-necked goose with an orange beak and webbed feet; at the beginning of the clip, its lower body is partially occluded by the rooftop chimney.

entities.name: Object A
entities.identification: A light-yellow package-like object carried by Person A, with a rounded end face, two dark circular spots, and some blue markings visible.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A short brown-haired person wearing purple long sleeves, a burgundy sleeveless top, gray-brown pants, and black shoes, and carrying Object A.

entities.name: gray street surface
entities.identification: The broad, flat gray paved area where Person A and Animal A are located.

entities.name: dark-gray tiled roof
entities.identification: The dark-gray sloped roof in the foreground; staggered roof tiles are visible at the beginning of the clip, while only a small portion remains in the lower-left corner at the end of the clip.

entities.name: rooftop chimney
entities.identification: The chimney assembly on the foreground roof; in this clip, mainly a gray cover plate and two brown vent pipes with curved hooded tops are visible.

entities.name: green median grass
entities.identification: The flat green grassy area in the upper part of the image, separated from the street surface by the light-colored curb.

entities.name: wooden bench
entities.identification: The brown wooden-plank bench on the grass, with dark supports; the portion within the frame changes with the camera.

entities.name: small light-blue seat-surface object
entities.identification: The small light-blue object on the right end of the wooden bench's seat surface, with a slender middle section, wing-like pointed corners, and a protruding tail end.

entities.name: light-colored curb
entities.identification: The beige-gray, narrow, elongated segmented boundary separating the green median grass from the gray street surface.

entities.name: thin gray upright pole
entities.identification: The thin, long, straight gray pole in the grass on the image-right side of the wooden bench, with its upper end extending out of the frame.

entities.name: white short-line prompt
entities.identification: The three white radial short-line graphics above Animal A's head in the image.
